sequence_definition: Reuse registered full polymer sequences for precisely the exposed selected chains, including unresolved residues. MD/development sequences use existing PDB CA residues and MISATO molecular-component boundaries. This is source-relatedness, not proof that every aligned residue was a supervised coordinate.
interpretation: MD-only had3 related validation systems. Actual static exposure adds5 under bidirectional coverage, or7 when allowing a short query fragment to match part of a longer target. These criteria describe different similarity scopes, not alternative favorable filters.
Both A/B received these same static sources, so relatedness does not uniquely favor one recipe. It still limits claims about sequence-independent static-pretraining generalization.

Exact held-out system identities are not held-out protein families. No-hit systems are not established fold/scaffold-independent; released-baseline and historical h/v pretraining exposures are not covered.
